test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

H _ M T _ H O _ T C H O M _ C _ O _ T C

options.text: M C M T H C
O C T M C M
O C M T H M
H C M T O M

solution:
Given sequence: H _ M T _ H O _ T C H O M _ C _ O _ T C

 
• M C M T H C → H **M** M T **C** - H O **M** T C - H O M **T** C - **H** O **C** T C
 
• O C T M C M → H **O** M T C - H O **T** T C - H O M **M** C - **C** O M<
